prompt:
Listen to this {duration:.3f}-second audio. Detect every audible occurrence matching the queries below. Give separate start/end times for separate occurrences, relative to this window. Events may overlap. Do not infer sounds from the scene. Use only listed query_id integers. Return ONLY a valid JSON object with an events array. Each event object must have query_id (integer), start (number of seconds), and end (number of seconds). If none are audible, return an empty events array. Times must satisfy 0 <= start < end <= {duration:.3f}. Determine all event times from the audio. Do not provide confidence scores or explanations. Queries:
{queries}
note: Generated event spans; no native frame scores, PSDS or mpAUC. No GT included in prompts.
